# Translate Description controls before opening

For Bug 2061760 at revision 120631be1a28113287187f4b5bfc554a1fbc885f, the verification report says the first opening exposed a translation defect and the repaired dialog waits for translated button names before opening. The implementation report also says route replacement briefly exposed an unnamed button and used a translated button clone to preserve its label. When changing this dialog's opening or replacement flow, check accessible names on the first opening and during replacement. These are AI-reported findings and validation results; the supplied evidence does not include the final source diff or independent confirmation.

Scope: Calendar event Description navigation.
